summary: Implemented the PUB-03 public property-details route with contract-backed localized details, safe media placeholders, source/project/related-property sections, SSR/client hydration, SEO metadata, and protected seeker contact/viewing actions. Added component, SSR, visual, and accessibility coverage across all approved locales and device scopes.

verification.notes: Root syntax, contracts, API, and web TypeScript checks passed.
Workspace validation and ESLint passed with zero warnings.
6 property-details component tests passed, including API prefixing, locale direction, safe projection, action payloads, and loading/retry/permission/not-found states.
Full web suite passed: 27 Vitest tests and 66 Node/SSR/foundation tests.
Root suite passed: 443 API tests and the full web suite, including the PUB-03 SSR test.
Contracts, API, web client, and web SSR production builds passed.
No high-severity or higher dependency vulnerabilities reported.
Runtime API inventory completed; the details route and existing seeker action routes are implemented.
Recorded the nine new PUB-03 locale/device baselines; all 27 visual scenarios passed.
Final visual rerun passed all 27 scenarios across Arabic, English, Simplified Chinese, desktop, tablet, and mobile.
All 36 accessibility scenarios passed, including labeled forms, modal controls, one main landmark, and safe image states for PUB-03.
API environment check requires APP_ENV, API_HOST, and API_PORT. This frontend task uses deterministic browser fixtures and fail-closed protected actions; no production environment was accessed.
Agent Pack audit reported zero errors while frontend_012 was the sole in-progress task.

scopeNotes: No backend runtime, database model, OpenAPI, or Postman implementation was changed; the task consumes existing contracts only.
Public property media exposes metadata without a public delivery URL, so the gallery truthfully renders an unavailable-image state instead of inventing a URL.
Contact and viewing submissions use the existing authenticated seeker endpoints and fail closed to a sign-in permission state when no session is available.
The approved local PUB-03 export was used because external Figma/Drive references are not available in this environment.
knownGaps: API environment readiness remains pending until APP_ENV, API_HOST, and API_PORT are supplied for a non-production runtime check.
Live database/provider smoke checks were not run; they are outside this frontend task and require isolated non-production credentials and topology.
